data_fields.name: perception_range_by_type
data_fields.donor_constant: script table indexed by perception type, default senses range (values not read)

best_idea: An NPC keeps its current target while it stays alive and sensed, switches only to a strictly nearer hostile, and re-runs that pick on its own timer rather than every tick.
decision_why: Take the sticky target rule and the per-NPC pick timer for the MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 slots so a crowd does not flicker between targets and pick cost is bounded per NPC; reject the flee waypoint search for now since the duel has guard and stagger (row 3) and no flee rule in our rulings.
acceptance: A server test asserts that an NPC keeps its target while the target is alive and in free sight, switches only to a hostile strictly nearer than the target, drops the target when it leaves the NPC's perception range, and re-runs the pick only after its perception period (default 5000 ms, set per NPC).
